observations: Photo 0: Canon EF-S 18-55mm lens, front cap on, barrel reads 'Canon', 'EFS 18-55mm', 'IMAGE S...' (image stabilizer marking), zoom ring at 18mm, focus mode switch visible (AF/MF).
Photo 1: Same lens from front, front cap on, 'Canon' logo visible on cap, no glass elements visible.
Photo 2: Same lens from rear, rear cap on, 'Canon' embossed on rear cap, mount and electronic contacts not visible.
Background is a patterned cloth/bag material in all three photos, consistent single staging setup.
No glass element, front or rear, is visible in any photo since both caps are on in all shots.
No camera body is shown; the lens is photographed alone.

claims.evidence: This is a lens, not a camera body; lenses have no shutter and no shutter count. Photo 0 confirms item is a lens only, no camera shown.

claims.claim: No fungus or scratch on the lens
claims.evidence: Front and rear glass elements are covered by caps in photos 0, 1, and 2; no clear glass shot provided.

claims.claim: Original battery and charger, never repaired
claims.evidence: This lens model (EF-S 18-55mm) has no battery or charger of its own; it draws power from the camera body. No battery/charger is shown in any photo.
No origin marking, box, or import sticker shown in any photo.

risks.risk: Fungus, haze, or scratches on front/rear glass elements
risks.proof: Clear close-up photo of front element and rear element with caps off, lens held at an angle toward light
risks.if_unproven: priced as having fungus/haze (worst case, cosmetic/optical defect)

risks.proof: Video clip of lens mounted on a camera body showing IS switch toggled and stabilization effect in live view, or audible IS engage sound

risks.risk: Autofocus motor or aperture blades faulty
risks.proof: Video clip of lens mounted on camera showing autofocus racking and aperture blades closing/opening when stopped down

risks.risk: Mount contacts worn, corroded, or EF-S electronic chip damaged
risks.proof: Close-up photo of rear mount ring and contact pins
risks.if_unproven: priced as mount/contacts condition unknown, assume wear

risks.risk: Fungus/scratch claim and shutter-count/battery claims appear copy-pasted from a camera-body listing, suggesting a generic or careless ad rather than an accurate description
risks.proof: Seller providing lens-specific condition photos (glass, mount) instead of boilerplate camera-body text
risks.if_unproven: treated as unreliable seller description, no uplift from seller's claims

proof_requests: Close-up photo of front glass element with cap off, lens angled toward light to check for fungus/haze/scratches
Close-up photo of rear glass element with cap off
Close-up photo of rear mount and electronic contacts
Short video of lens mounted on a Canon camera body showing autofocus, zoom, and IS switch engaged
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable as a Canon EF-S 18-55mm kit lens from the barrel markings, but the glass elements are never shown (both caps on throughout) and several seller claims (shutter count, battery/charger) do not even apply to a lens, so condition must be priced at worst case pending proof.
